issues.title: [A1] Verify metric series in Prometheus
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** verify which metric series exist in Prometheus
**So that** we know if spanmetrics is on or off

## Task
Run:
```
kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/prometheus -- wget -qO- 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/series?match[]=traces_span_metrics_calls_total' | head
```
Same for `http_client_duration_milliseconds_count`.

## Done When
You know whether spanmetrics is on or off.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish

issues.title: [A2] Enable spanmetrics connector
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** enable the spanmetrics connector
**So that** traces_span_metrics_* series are visible in Prometheus

## Task
Enable the `spanmetrics` connector in `demo/otel-demo/values.yaml` (collector config block) and `helm upgrade` via `infra/bootstrap.ps1`.

## Done When
`traces_span_metrics_*` series visible in Prometheus.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish

issues.title: [A3] Verify prometheus-rules.yml is loaded
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** verify `infra/prometheus-rules.yml` is loaded into the Prometheus configmap
**So that** alert rules are active

## Task
Run:
```
kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/prometheus -- promtool rules list
```
If not loaded, add a helm-upgrade step or sidecar that patches the configmap on every bootstrap.

## Done When
`promtool rules list` shows the `aiops-demo` group.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish

issues.title: [A4] Tighten alert rule timings
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** tighten alert rule timings
**So that** the demo loop fires in ~90 s instead of several minutes

## Task
In every rule in `infra/prometheus-rules.yml`: `for: 30s` → `for: 15s`, `[2m]` → `[1m]`.

## Done When
One commit, one helm upgrade, alert fires within 90 s of flag flip.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish

issues.title: [A5] Extract prometheus_adapter.py
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** extract the inline Prometheus normalizer into `aiops/tools/alerts/`
**So that** alert normalization is modular and source-agnostic

## Task
Pull `_prometheus_alert_to_candidate` from `demo/ui/server.py:205` into `aiops/tools/alerts/prometheus_adapter.py`. Register capability `alerts.normalize.prometheus`. Server calls `registry.call('alerts.normalize.prometheus', raw_alert=...)`.

## Done When
One smoke test confirms the adapter produces the same shape as before.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish

issues.title: [A6] Stub datadog, cloudwatch, alertmanager adapters
issues.body:
**As a** dev team
**I want to** stub source adapters for Datadog, CloudWatch, and Alertmanager push
**So that** multi-source alert normalization is supported (and demo-able)

## Task
Create `datadog_adapter.py`, `cloudwatch_adapter.py`, `alertmanager_push_adapter.py` under `aiops/tools/alerts/`. Each handles one minimal payload shape and returns a canonical `Alert`. Registered capabilities: `alerts.normalize.datadog`, `alerts.normalize.cloudwatch`, `alerts.normalize.alertmanager`.

## Done When
The 3 capabilities appear in `/api/health`'s `registered_capabilities`.

## Assignee
Dev A — RA-001 Alert Triage finish
